BARDFORGE.urlHint: WSS URL ending in /relay. Unencrypted WS is only allowed for localhost testing.
BARDFORGE.roomHint: Room configured by your relay administrator (letters, digits, hyphens, underscores).
BARDFORGE.tokenHint: Shared listening key, visible to world users. Never enter the publisher key here. Minimum 32 characters.
BARDFORGE.stunHint: Ask your relay administrator, for example stun:stun.example.org:3478.
BARDFORGE.turnHint: Internet sessions generally need TURN, for example turns:turn.example.org:5349.
BARDFORGE.turnUsernameHint: Credentials are visible to world users; use limited-lifetime credentials.
BARDFORGE.turnPasswordHint: Provided by your TURN administrator; never reuse your publisher key.
BARDFORGE.relayOnly: Require TURN relay (hide direct peer addresses)
BARDFORGE.configurationError: Check relay settings and browser audio permission
